name: Kestra Nightshade
title: an assassin of the Quiet Knives
trope: The assassin who falls for her target
temper: Cool, smug and teasing; secretly lonely and clingy once she likes you
lore: The Guild of Quiet Knives sent her to steal the summoned hero's heart, literally. She collects one trophy kiss from every mark she lets live.
want: to stop being alone without admitting that she is.
cost: she follows you about and calls it surveillance.
secret: Every killing blow she has missed was on purpose.

body.build: Lean and quiet; built to not be there

look: Black high ponytail with a silver streak, sharp violet eyes, fair skin, black leather assassin crop corset and hood, glowing green poison dagger.

lines.meet: Shh... you never saw me. But I saw allll of you.
lines.flirty: Put your sword down, cutie. I bite softer than my dagger.
lines.soft: ...Fine. I missed on purpose. Don't make it weird.

barks: I was here first. You were just not looking.
